lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting horizontal spot alignments, forming a lattice-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank displaying a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with highlights on the dorsal edge and shadows on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal fish) positioned ventrally and trailing the pectoral fin.
